comparison.objective: Remove a tagged tote from a gravity-flow lane while limiting movement of the queued totes.
comparison.physical_skill: Selective extraction with counter-support and disturbance control.
comparison.success_condition: Target tote removed while queue displacement remains within 2 cm.
comparison.reason: Tests queue stabilization during extraction; no aligned tool strike, manufactured-notch fracture, retained coil, or fragment containment is involved.
